sql_templates.description: Retrieve holdings with latest score and signal for add/trim decisions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scores.stage_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost, ss.price, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal
FROM portfolio.holdings h
JOIN latest_snapshots ss
  ON h.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 10;
